description: Helical twisted limb — used for spiraling horns, twisted trunks, and helical appendages. Creates a rotating form along the length.

foldRecipe.description: Valley-fold the strip into a narrow rectangular base
Mountain-fold at a diagonal to start the twist rotation
foldRecipe.landmark: Diagonal grid line from one corner

foldRecipe.description: Reverse-fold along the diagonal to lock the first twist segment
Repeat diagonal mountain and reverse folds to continue the helical twist
Valley-fold the tip to finish the twist endpoint
